remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled first-floor unit in a charming multi-family home. Ideally located just steps from Norwalk Hospital, SoNo's vibrant restaurants and shops, and the train station for easy commuting. This light-filled apartment with private entrance blends modern comfort with thoughtful luxury details throughout, including solar panels for energy efficiency, new oak floors and open living space, modern kitchen with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances and sleek finishes, updated bathrooms with designer touches. Street parking available; driveway parking. Small backyard shared with upper unit, private deck. Laundry in unit, most appliances are brand new. Keyless entry being installed for added convenience, Ring doorbell. One year plus lease, application with credit check required, ask about pet restrictions.
